major_events: Entering the Spatial Fold in Great Ruins: Qin Mu and the Borderless Village elders cross spatial barriers in the Great Ruins to search for the mythical Carefree Village [第237章 禁区].

Finding the False Birth Home: Inside the spatial fold, Qin Mu discovers a preserved village and an infant shirt embroidered with 'Qin', initially believing it to be his birth home before realizing the calligraphy style differs slightly from his amulet [第238章 迟到的母爱].

Retrieving Carefree Village Relics: Village Chief and Apothecary return from exploring the broken giant ship in the spatial fold with objects marked with the 'Qin' name, confirming Qin Mu's clan identity [第240章 新的希望].

Ascension as the Human Emperor: Village Chief officially passes down his teachings and the title of 'Human Emperor' to Qin Mu, presenting him with the responsibility of protecting humanity [第241章 下一代人皇].
Accidental Slaying of Buddhist Disciple Foxin: Prince's guards mistake Foxin for Qin Mu because Foxin is holding the Heavenly Devil Scripture, executing him from a distance [第256章 请道剑，斩真龙].

Rescuing the Poisoned Emperor: Qin Mu disguised as a monk rescues the paralyzed and poisoned Emperor of Yankang (延丰帝) from his internal enemies and uses medicinal baths to cure him [第262章 皇帝神藏] / [第265章 第四天王].

Executing Prince Ling Yuxia: Qin Mu uses his sword to execute Prince Ling Yuxia on the coronation altar to rescue the captive Heavenly Kings of the Heavenly Devil Sect, despite the Emperor's presence [第266章 杀皇帝！].

Entering the Canyon Deep via Ming Bie Shells: Qin Mu, Dragon Qilin, and the white bat siblings hide inside the empty pupa cases on the back of a giant Ming Bie insect to travel safely to its underwater nest in the canyon [第302章 冥谷深渊].

Qin Hanzhen's Sword Strike: Armed with the Carefree Sword brought by Qin Mu, the wood-bound Qin Hanzhen (Qin Mu's father) repels the Youdu deity Zhen Xing Jun, forcing her to flee the ship [第313章 父与子].
Rescuing Princess Mother Xiong Xiyu: Qin Mu saves the poisoned Princess Mother of West Earth's Zhentian Palace and her daughter Xiong Qi'er from their pursuers in Great Ruins [第321章 率性所行].
Ma Ye's Ascension to Rulai: Old Ma Ye returns to Da Lei Yin Temple, inherits the position of Rulai, and attains the 'Da Fan Tian' realm [第329章 血汪洋].

Discovering the Magpie Bridge Technique: Qin Mu deciphers a golden scroll to find the 'Que Qiao Jue' (Magpie Bridge Technique) for repairing the broken Divine Bridge, shocking the Village Chief and Yankang Guoshi [第338章 大格局].
Verifying the True and False Overlord Body: Qin Mu battles Xu Shenghua to test their respective 'Overlord Body' abilities, using complex calculations and sword-arts [第357章 真假霸体].
Defending the Great Ruins Dragon Pulse: Qin Mu and his companions clash with Huan Long Jun, who is attempting to extract the Great Ruins dragon pulses [第366章 真龙之主].
Huan Long Jun's Poisoning and Retreat: Qin Mu poisons Huan Long Jun's avatar with 'Three Ruin Powder' (三破散) to force his retreat [第376章 死战].
Blind's Divine Spear Awakening: Blind's sealed divine spear awakens, unleashing unmatched spear-art and driving back their formidable enemies [第388章 神枪觉醒].
Fishing the Sun: Qin Mu, the Shepherd of Sun, and the Dragon Qilin use a giant needle and thread to hook the fallen sun and lift it back to the sky [第399章 钓太阳].
Reigniting the Sun at Sun Well: Qin Mu and the Sun Herd clan use the Sun Well to reignite the fading sun, saving the region from eternal darkness [第391章 太阳井].
Battle Against Xing An: Qin Mu, Blind, and Emperor Yanfeng battle the body-collecting tyrant Xing An, who has stolen divine body parts of various master cultivators [第404章 无敌].
Re-summoning the Souls of Deceased Heroes: Qin Mu uses Youdu arrays to summon the spirits of the deceased heroes back to the mortal realm [第316章 魂归来兮].
character_state_transitions: Qin Mu (秦牧): Becomes the successor to the 'Human Emperor' title, receiving the lineage and duties from the dying Village Chief [第241章 下一代人皇].
Old Ma Ye (马爷): From a village elder and former deputy head of Da Lei Yin Temple to the new Rulai (如来) of Da Lei Yin Temple, achieving the 'Da Fan Tian' realm [第329章 血汪洋].

Emperor Yanfeng (延丰帝): From being a poisoned, paralyzed prisoner of the rebel Prince and sects [第261章 厉天行与皇帝] to being cured by Qin Mu's medicinal baths and recovering his cultivation, eventually reclaiming his throne [第265章 第四天王] / [第266章 杀皇帝！].

Granny Si (司婆婆): Suffers from a demonic takeover as Li Tianxing's consciousness merges with her soul [第246章 似幻还真], which is temporarily suppressed by Ma Ye's Buddhist avatar and eventually stabilized.
Xiong Xiyu (熊惜雨): From the poisoned, chased Princess Mother (奶夔) of West Earth's Zhentian Palace [第321章 率性所行] to being protected and treated by Qin Mu, beginning her recovery in Great Ruins.

Qin Hanzhen (秦汉珍): From a completely woodenized tree-person trapped in the divine tree of the ship [第311章 树中人] to temporarily recovering partial movement, gripping the Carefree Sword, and using his sword-art to wound Zhen Xing Jun [第313章 父与子].

Huan Long Jun (豢龙君): From a proud, high-and-mighty deity collecting dragon pulses in Great Ruins [第366章 真龙之主] to being poisoned by Qin Mu's Three Ruin Powder [第376章 死战] and later forced to compromise and submit under the threat of Qin Mu's techniques [第385章 镇江龙].
Prince Ling Yuxia (灵玉夏): From the ambitious rebel prince set to be crowned as the new puppet emperor of the sects [第266章 杀皇帝！] to being executed by Qin Mu's sword-art.
Foxin (佛心): From the promising Buddhist disciple of Da Lei Yin Temple [第255章 魔性太重] to being accidentally killed by the prince's guards' flying sword [第256章 请道剑，斩真龙].
Blind (瞎子): From a blind village elder whose divine spear-art was sealed and dormant [第383章 瞎眼神枪] to awakening his divine spear and displaying unmatched spear-art that shocks their foes [第388章 神枪觉醒].
long_form_mechanisms: Que Qiao Jue (鹊桥诀) & Divine Bridge Repair: The Divine Bridge is a spiritual passage connecting a cultivator's mortal realms to the divine realm. Since it was broken in the current era, cultivators cannot achieve true godhood. The Magpie Bridge Technique uses precise mathematical and spatial calculations to build a bridge structure that bridges the gap, allowing energy to cross and repair the Divine Bridge [第338章 大格局].

Heavenly Devil Scripture (大育天魔经) Multi-aspect Cultivation: The scripture includes various sections such as the 'Zaohua Tianmo Gong' (creating protective inner clothing from soul energy), 'Zaohua Xiantian Gong' (reverting the body to a baby-like state of breathing and purity), and 'Zaohua Diyuan Gong' (connecting to the earth to absorb grounding energy and strengthen the primordial spirit) [第255章 魔性太重].

Ming Bie (螟鳖) Pupa Hiding: The Ming Bie is a water-dwelling beast that protects its offspring. The beast carries large, hollow egg casings (pupa cases) on its back. By hiding inside these casings, cultivators mask their aura with the scent of the offspring, preventing the beast from attacking and allowing them to be transported safely through underwater currents to its deep canyon nest [第302章 冥谷深渊].

Three Ruin Powder (三破散) Poisoning: A multi-layered poison developed by Qin Mu that utilizes a combination of restorative spiritual ingredients and deadly toxins. It targets the physical body (body ruin), spiritual energy (spirit ruin), and soul (soul ruin) simultaneously, causing them to disintegrate. It is powerful enough to affect deities [第376章 死战].

Fishing the Sun: The process of retrieving a fallen sun by using a giant needle and thread. The Shepherd of Sun uses specialized solar arrays to locate the fallen star, and then throws a needle threaded with solar silk to hook the sun's core, pulling it back up through the sky [第399章 钓太阳].

Zhentian Palace's Elemental Mimicry (万物有灵): The West Earth cultivation system based on 'Everything Has Spirit.' Cultivators can communicate with natural elements and invoke their spirits to animate terrain (e.g., turning mountains into giant rock titans or raising rivers to crush opponents) [第321章 率性所行] / [第451章 第十八式].

Xing An's Body Harvesting and Grafting: Xing An collects the divine body parts of the most powerful cultivators of his era (such as Blind's eyes or Cripple's legs) and grafts them onto his own body. He uses specialized medical-refining arrays to integrate these parts, allowing him to use their peak divine abilities simultaneously [第402章 星犴].

Sun Well (太阳井) Energy Ignition: The Sun Well is a specialized geothermal-solar nexus in Great Ruins. It acts as an ignition chamber where concentrated solar energy is injected to rekindle a dying or cold sun, generating the heat and light needed to restore its orbit [第391章 太阳井].
continuity_observations: Village Chief's Passing of the Torch: The Village Chief's physical condition is continuously deteriorating. Realizing his time is short, he officially designates Qin Mu as the new Human Emperor [第241章 下一代人皇], a title that becomes Qin Mu's primary duty and narrative driver in subsequent chapters.

Granny Si's Internal Demon: Granny Si's split personality/demonic possession by the former cult leader Li Tianxing is a recurring danger. It begins to manifest strongly [第246章 似幻还真], requiring the assistance of Da Lei Yin Temple and Ma Ye to suppress, showing a continuous struggle between her true self and the demon.

The Identity of Qin Fengqing: Qin Mu's origin search spans the entire chunk. He starts by searching for Carefree Village in the forbidden fold [第237章 禁区], finds the family artifacts [第240章 新的希望], and finally confronts his birth father in the tree [第311章 树中人], confirming his true name is Qin Fengqing and he belongs to the Kaihuang clan [第312章 镇星君].

The Carefree Sword (无忧剑): The Carefree Sword is introduced as a family heirloom that Qin Mu carries. Its true owner and purpose are revealed when Qin Mu brings it to the giant ship, where his father, Qin Hanzhen, wields it to repel the Youdu deity [第313章 父与子].

The Magpie Bridge Technique's Impact: The discovery of the Magpie Bridge Technique [第338章 大格局] bridges the gap between mortal cultivation and divine realms. It changes the goal of the major characters (Village Chief, Guoshi, Yanfeng) from simple reform to ascending to godhood, altering the political and martial landscape.

Huan Long Jun's Transformation: Huan Long Jun starts as an antagonistic deity trying to reclaim dragon pulses [第366章 真龙之主], but after being poisoned by Qin Mu [第376章 死战] and outsmarted in the river [第385章 镇江龙], he is forced to submit and becomes a reluctant ally/mount, showing a complete shift in his role.

The Shepherds of Sun and the Fallen Sun: The threat of darkness in Great Ruins is linked to the fallen suns. Qin Mu's interaction with the Sun Herd clan at the Sun Well [第391章 太阳井] and his act of fishing the sun [第399章 钓太阳] resolves a major environmental crisis in the ruins, building on the lore of Great Ruins' diurnal cycles.

West Earth's Pursuers: The rescue of Xiong Xiyu in Great Ruins [第321章 率性所行] introduces the West Earth's Zhentian Palace faction. This subplot grows over the chunk, culminating in Qin Mu traveling to West Earth and facing their city-manipulating spells [第451章 第十八式].
style_observations: Blending of Mathematics and Cultivation (术数): The author frequently uses concepts of geometry, coordinates, and spatial dimensions to explain magical formations, sword-arts, and spatial folding (e.g., Qin Mu calculating the spatial dimensions of the Magpie Bridge) [第338章 大格局].

Humorous and Pragmatic Protagonist: Qin Mu's personality is characterized by a mix of extreme pragmatism (readiness to use poison, trickery, or make enemies wear monk robes) and a pure, child-like curiosity, creating a lighthearted tone despite the dark setting [第265章 第四天王] / [第376章 死战].

Vivid Environmental Contrast: The setting shifts between the dark, dangerous, and mysterious Great Ruins (where gods reside as stone statues) and the politically corrupt, reforming Yankang Empire, highlighting the contrast between ancient myth and modern progress [第266章 杀皇帝！] / [第395章 殿下生猛].

De-romanticized Cultivator Society: Cultivators and sects are shown as self-interested landowners who exploit normal citizens rather than noble seekers of truth, driving the necessity of the political reforms championed by the Emperor and Guoshi [第265章 第四天王].

Delayed Payoff of Inherited Skills: The mundane skills taught by the village elders (Apothecary's medicine, Deaf's painting, Blind's spear-art, Cripple's theft) are initially presented as simple survival tools but are later revealed to be peak divine-level techniques [第402章 星犴].

Scale and Grandeur in Spellcasting: The scale of spells is immense, with characters manipulating entire rivers, using suns as blunt weapons [第395章 殿下生猛], or animating entire cities to chase down enemies [第451章 第十八式].

creation_family_evidence.title_and_edition: The source file name '《牧神记》（校对版全本）作者：宅猪.txt' indicates it is a proofread ('校对版') and completed edition of the web novel by author Zhaizhu ('宅猪').
creation_family_evidence.chapter_heading_regularity: The text features uniform chapter division formatting using Chinese chapter numbers ('第237章' to '第451章') followed by a space and a title. This represents the typical structure of a cleaned web novel compilation.
creation_family_evidence.textual_content_and_universe: The story revolves around Qin Mu ('秦牧') and specific unique terminology created by Zhaizhu, such as the Overlord Body ('霸体'), the Great Ruins ('大墟'), the Magpie Bridge Technique ('鹊桥诀'), and the Yankang Empire ('延康') setting.
creation_family_evidence.cleanliness_of_source: The text has been heavily edited to remove typical web serialization artifacts such as editor notes, advertisements for votes/tickets, and 'to be continued' placeholders, confirming its nature as a '校对版' (proofread version).

originality_risks: Cliché 'Overlord Body' Specialness: The trope of the protagonist possessing a unique, legendary constitution (the Overlord Body) that makes him naturally superior to others and allows him to learn any technique is a very common xianxia cliché [第357章 真假霸体].

Ex Machina Village Elders: Whenever the protagonist faces an insurmountable foe, one of the disabled elders from his village (like Blind or Cripple) conveniently reveals a hidden divine power that easily resolves the conflict [第388章 神枪觉醒] / [第404章 无敌].

Repetitive 'Rebellion and Restoration' Cycle: The political plot relies on the standard cycle of a crown prince launching a coup backed by conservative sects, only for the protagonist to rescue the emperor and restore the old regime through raw power and medical miracles [第266章 杀皇帝！].

Simplistic Binary of Reform vs. Tradition: The conflict between the reforming Yankang Empire and the traditional sects is depicted in a somewhat black-and-white manner, where the sects are invariably greedy landowners and the reformers are progressives, reducing political complexity [第265章 第四天王].
